scope: Only the exact coordinator self-PID/procfs guard, its receipt field, unique v3 helper names/preflight/review binding, and mapping of the actual bounded diagnostic receipts. No whole-runner or scientific review was repeated.

findings.observed: load_budget now reads the first PID field of /proc/self/stat, compares it to os.getpid(), records both values and fails on inequality. execute_attempt calls load_budget before worker_launch_attempted or Popen. The guard neither translates numeric PIDs nor searches unrelated processes. Existing child parent/group/session/start-time checks remain necessary and unchanged.

The v3 helper performs the same self-identity guard before the owned PID probe Popen. Once the child identity read succeeds, it records STARTED_PENDING_VALIDATION with the actual Popen PID/start identity before checking parent/group/liveness. Validation failure remains failed; the existing owned-child cleanup and cumulative debit finalizer remain in place.

The helper accepts only c4_v3, uses create-only v3 intent/host/amendment/UNKNOWN namespaces, requires C04_V3 preflight, and checks this independent review against the actual new runner bytes/SHA. It retains all earlier receipts and the same memory-policy V2 and CPU/memory caps.

The default diagnostic receipt records a pre-child FileNotFoundError for /proc/2/stat. The separately executed consistent-context receipt records parent os PID478390 equal to both proc self/numeric PID, child Popen PID478391 equal to proc child and child stdout, parent478390, group/session478391, matching start identity, exit0 and completed cleanup. This supports the explicit context selection for the next attempt without fabricating a PID translation.

actual_diagnostic_receipts.nested_status_interpretation: Preserved stale initialization; the actual traceback follows Popen and is not evidence that no metadata probe was started

total_note: Displayed subtotal from the root diagnosis; immutable per-attempt binary64 amounts remain authoritative and the unchanged preparation ledger recomputes their maximum-per-attempt sum. No earlier cost or failure is erased or charged twice.

limits.execution_context: The root's already-authorized require_escalated context with the observed consistent PID/procfs namespace; this static review does not add permissions or alter access controls
